note_page_limit = 20

def fetch_all_note_summaries(search_query):
    page_index = 0
    collected_summaries = []
    while True:
        note_page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
            access_token=simple_note_access_token,
            query=search_query,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=note_page_limit,
        )
        collected_summaries.extend(note_page)
        if len(note_page) < note_page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return collected_summaries

bucket_search_summaries = fetch_all_note_summaries("Bucket List")
print([
    {"note_id": summary["note_id"], "title": summary["title"]}
    for summary in bucket_search_summaries
])
